Record Class ConfirmedCauseLabelModels.Suggestion

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
com.shaft.doctor.label.ConfirmedCauseLabelModels.Suggestion
Record Components:
schemaVersion - suggestion schema version
matched - whether a stored label was found
signature - looked-up signature key (blank when none)
causeCategory - suggested category, or UNKNOWN when unmatched
displayAlias - short alias, or blank when unmatched
message - human-readable status
storePath - relative or absolute store path used (never contains evidence file contents)
Enclosing class:
ConfirmedCauseLabelModels
public static record ConfirmedCauseLabelModels.Suggestion(String schemaVersion, boolean matched, String signature, CauseCategory causeCategory, String displayAlias, String message, String storePath) extends Record
Suggestion returned when a signature matches a stored label.
